Lickilicky

Normal

Sinnoh · Generation 4

Lickilicky is a Normal-type Licking Pokémon first found in Sinnoh (Generation 4). It stands 1.7 m tall and weighs 140 kg. It evolves from Lickitung. Its highest base stat is HP (110), with a base stat total of 515.
